prompts.logo:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final production transparent primary logo for Yomiru.
Reference image role: design reference only. The user selected Option 2, the CENTER reading fox concept. Recreate and refine ONLY that center concept as ONE standalone high-quality near-square logo, without any presentation panel or mockup.
An original friendly coral-orange fox with large triangular ears, cream ear interiors and muzzle, closed happy navy curved eyes, tiny navy nose, two little paws resting on a dark midnight-navy rounded subtitle card, and its cream-tipped orange tail curving up at the right. The card has one wide pale-yellow #FFEAB5 caption bar above one slightly narrower pale-blue #A8E6FF caption bar. Under the card, integrated into the same dark navy sticker base, exact large readable cream rounded wordmark "Yomiru" (Y o m i r u). Keep the charming confident silhouette and proportions of Option 2. Bold smooth navy outlines with a cream outer keyline around the whole sticker. Refined flat anime stationery illustration, minimal restrained tonal shading, no photographic texture.
Centered whole logo with an even modest transparent margin. Actual transparent alpha outside the sticker, no background rectangle, no checkerboard painted in the image, no shadows outside the silhouette. The cream outer stroke and dark inner silhouette must ensure contrast on white, off-white, and dark backgrounds. No extra symbols, no labels, no "Option 2", no slogan, no other text. Only a single complete logo.
Correction for final export: keep exactly the selected fox, subtitle card and Yomiru composition, but make the outer silhouette perfectly clean and smooth with no distressed texture, flecks or decorative particles. Instead of transparency, put the entire sticker on a PERFECTLY FLAT uniform chroma-key green #00ff00 background. Green must appear only outside the sticker. No shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, checkerboard, floor plane, lighting variation or green spill. Leave at least 7% uniform green margin on all four sides. Solid cream outer keyline. One logo, no extra content.
prompts.icon:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final text-free Yomiru icon, derived creatively from the reference logo.
Reference role: brand design reference. Keep the same friendly coral-orange fox, cream muzzle and ear interiors, closed happy navy eyes, tiny nose, little paws over a navy subtitle card, cream-tipped tail rising at the right. TWO blank caption bars only: wide pale yellow #FFEAB5 above narrower pale blue #A8E6FF.
Produce ONE simplified compact square-proportioned icon. Remove the ENTIRE Yomiru wordmark and its lower plaque. The card ends just below the blue caption bar. Make fox head, ears and tail larger bold simple shapes to remain recognizable at 16/32/48 pixels. Reduce tiny details and gradients, clean flat colors with thick smooth midnight-navy contours and smooth cream outer keyline. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, monograms or typographic glyphs anywhere.
Centered whole icon, 8% margin on all sides, no crop. BACKGROUND is perfectly flat uniform chroma-key green #00ff00, appearing only outside the icon. No background gradient, texture, shadow, reflections, checkerboard, floor plane, lighting variation, green spill, distressed speckles, particles or extra marks. This green will be removed to make true alpha; the icon itself must have smooth clean edges. One icon only, no mockups.
prompts.social:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: wide transparent brand artwork for a 1200x630 Yomiru repository/social preview.
Reference image role: approved brand reference. Make ONE spacious WIDE LANDSCAPE composition approximately 1.91:1, not a square and not a repeated logo sheet. On the left place the SAME friendly coral-orange fox from the reference, cream muzzle and ears, closed happy navy eyes, tiny navy nose, paws over its navy card with a pale-yellow #FFEAB5 bar above a pale-blue #A8E6FF bar, cream-tipped tail curving up at right. NO wordmark under the fox. On the right place exact large rounded cream wordmark "Yomiru" with thick midnight-navy backing and fine cream outer keyline, aligned to center vertically. Under the wordmark add TWO blank short stacked rounded lines, pale yellow above pale blue, as a restrained echo of paired captions. No other text, no slogan. Gentle friendly flat anime stationery illustration, restrained shading, smooth navy outline and cream outer sticker border, matching the reference. Strong compact composition with generous safe margin of at least 8% all around, artwork fitting fully within the central 80% width and 80% height. Contrast-safe on white and dark.
BACKGROUND: one PERFECTLY FLAT uniform chroma-key green #00ff00. Green occurs only outside the artwork; no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, checkerboard, floor plane, lighting variation, green spill, distressed speckles or particles. This will be removed to transparent alpha. No large canvas rectangle behind the subject. No extra foxes, no mockups, no labels.
